metadata.title: Governance DRep Discovery Plan Tasks
metadata.description: DRep Discovery + Wallet Current Vote Display, organized as a vertical-slice plan. Each slice is a thin end-to-end capability — minimum main-process/backend + IPC + store + UI, demoable behind the REAL IPC path, with its own Storybook + Jest + i18n landed in the same slice. There is no terminal i18n phase, no terminal test phase, and no pure-backend phase. Three sequential foundation slices close the browse -> select -> delegate journey for both wallet types: slice-1 (walking skeleton + log/analytics sanitization floor), slice-2 (software-wallet delegate), and slice-3 (hardware-wallet delegate). Three parallelizable tracks then thicken the product: Track D (discovery: detail -> cohort+badges+banner -> search/show-all -> favorites -> refresh+selfnode+release-verification), Track V (current vote: plumbing+core -> enrichment), and Track A (anchor: hardened-fetch+givenName -> completion). Two floors are never thinned across slices: the log/analytics sanitization invariant (lands in slice-1, asserted by every later slice) and the anchor transport security guards (land complete in anchor-1). Product content includes: BMVG citation, four-category badge, default-cohort-as-Recommended, 6-epoch drepActivity floor, CurrentVoteSummary live status badge, CIP-119 givenName + anchor links. All newly introduced en-US and ja-JP copy remains preliminary with a leading !!! until the final manual review at the end of the feature cycle. The slice-1 final pass (defect fixes) is tracked separately in task-plans/slice-1-final-pass-sprint.yaml. 2026-06-15 final-pass status refresh (FP-5): task-103 (query service) moved partial -> complete after FP-1 added the cardano-cli network flag and FP-9 renamed the DRep status literal to the ledger-correct active/inactive; the only residual limitation is the design constraint that drep-state exposes just expiry. slice-1 auditSummary.statusCounts updated to complete 8 / partial 0 / verified 3, and task-103/task-104/task-107 statusReason text was confirmed accurate and refreshed. 2026-06-15 final-pass bookkeeping (FP-6): the dead per-task origin property (legacy task numbers no tooling reads) was removed from all task entries and stale split/dissolved/hour-split parentheticals were cleaned from task descriptions; the original task lineage is preserved in git history. 2026-06-16 slice-1 closeout (Next Steps reconciliation): the disposable Next Steps section of task-plans/slice-1-final-pass-review.md was removed after confirming items 1-5 are already tracked across the tasking and PRDs; its only residual not previously in the tasking — the optional CLI-robustness cleanups (conway era-retry structured signal + real-binary argv smoke test) distilled from the slice-1 final-pass standing risks — was folded in as task-169 (ux-refinement phase, low priority).

tasks.title: Add main-process DRep query service
tasks.description: Implement the slice-1 singleton GovernanceQueryService in source/main/ for the DRep list query using the confirmed cardano-cli path and shared DRep Discovery types. The broader detail, vote-position, and wallet-governance-status surfaces are deferred to their later owning slices (slice-4 detail, Track V, Track A).
tasks.statusReason: Singleton service is wired from CardanoNode with selfnode/non-selfnode modes and a reset() boundary. Parser consumes real CLI tuple output (`[[credential, state], ...]`), derives CIP-129 DRep IDs from credential hashes via Cardano.DRepID.cip129FromCredential, requires an integer epoch scalar from `query tip`, retries with `conway` when the installed CLI rejects the `latest` era alias, and rejects partial anchors or non-string anchor fields instead of emitting broken placeholder data. Voting power is nullable when `--include-stake` returns no stake. 10 s CLI_TIMEOUT_MS budget emits Timeout. Both slice-1 final-pass follow-ups that previously held this task at partial are fixed this sprint: FP-1 added the required network flag (`--mainnet` / `--testnet-magic <N>`) to the CLI argv after the subcommand, so live queries no longer fail with the "Missing: (--mainnet | --testnet-magic NATURAL)" CLI error; FP-9 renamed the status literal to the ledger-correct `active | inactive` (derived from `expiry <= currentEpoch`), aligning with shared-design-tokens §1 and the downstream slice-5 Threshold / cv-2 status badges. Focused Jest coverage (26 tests passing) validates: tuple parsing, era fallback, raw oversized-lovelace preservation through `json-bigint`, strict tip parsing, strict scalar validation for tip/expiry/anchor fields, parse failures, timeout, CliNotFound, cache reset, dedup, and the network flag in spawn argv for both mainnet and testnet clusters. Representative drep-state / drep-stake-distribution / gov-state fixtures (including a lovelace value above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) are committed under tests/mocks/governance/. Moved to complete: the only remaining limitation is a known design constraint, not unfinished work — the ledger's drep-state output exposes just `expiry`, so the parser can ground only the two `active`/`inactive` states; `expiring` is intentionally a renderer-derived display state and `retired` is deferred until a distinct unregistration signal exists. Live synced-node confirmation that the UTxO-HD backend serves drep-state from in-memory ledger tables remains a manual release-verification item (FP-8 / FP-11), not implementation work.
acceptanceCriteria: Representative `drep-state`, `drep-stake-distribution`, and `gov-state` fixtures from a synced node are committed under tests/mocks/governance/ before this service merges, including at least one lovelace value above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
Requests latest local state on load and on user refresh, deduplicating in-flight requests and retaining last-successful data only for stale-while-refresh continuity.
Bulk `--all-dreps` is invoked once per latest-state refresh; per-DRep CLI invocations are forbidden.
Reads the captured node socket path from CardanoNode and passes it through `CARDANO_NODE_SOCKET_PATH` in spawn env.
Parses CLI stdout with json-bigint in lossless mode and constructs BigNumber values from raw decimal strings; native JSON.parse -> Number -> BigNumber is forbidden.
Includes a fixture/test with lovelace greater than 9_007_199_254_740_991 that round-trips parse -> IPC decimal string -> BigNumber rehydration losslessly.

Gated to environments where the real cardano-cli is on PATH (Nix shell). If task-161 lands first, apply the structured era-retry signal to both phase calls.
